description: This file defines and extends classes for TagExpression modeling, including classes like Matcher and Never, with methods for evaluation, string representation, and wildcards handling. It also patches existing classes for backward compatibility.

classes.name: Matcher
classes.description: A class for matching tags with wildcards using filename-matching patterns.

classes.name: Never
classes.description: A TagExpression class that always evaluates to False.

methods.name: _Expression_check
methods.description: Checks if tags match this tag-expression, backward-compatible to v1.

methods.name: _Expression_to_string
methods.description: Provides a formatted string representation of the expression.

methods.name: _Not_to_string
methods.description: Provides a compact string representation for Not expressions.

methods.name: contains_wildcards
methods.description: Indicates if a text contains glob wildcards.
